QuestInfo.name: Tess's Identity
QuestInfo.2: Tess tells you that he's Kyrin's brother and Destonen's son. He explains that he and Kyrin are half-elves, so they don't age much. \r\nTess wants you to keep the information a secret from Kyrin and Athena Pierce until he's ready to reveal himself to them.

0.0: My name is Tess. I am... Kyrin's older brother. \r\n#L0##bWait, what?#l\n#k
0.1: Heh. Kyrin's a lot older than she looks. Our mother was a half-elf. Since we're mixed, we age slower than humans after we reach a certain age. \r\n#L0##bWhy were you chasing that bunny?#l\n#k
0.2: I wanted to question it. All I know is, he's #bpart of some shady organization#k. My current objective is to stop that group from... Well, that's none of your business. \r\n#L0##bNo, I want to hear more about the shady group!#l\n#k
0.3: Just know this: Something #bmajor#k is going to happen in Maple World soon. It's why I came out of hiding. Heck,I even took a Job Advancement test! \r\n#L0##bWhat was the deal with the mask? Isn't that a little over-dramatic?#l\n#k
0.4: I didn't want Kyrin to notice the family resemblance.\r\n#L0##bDon't you think you should tell Kyrin you're her brother?#l\n#k
0.5: What's the point? We were never that close. Last time I saw her, she was still in diapers. \r\nI mean, I guess I'll tell her sooner or later, but until then, let's just keep this between you and me, hm?

yes.0: I knew I could count on you. You really are a lot like Kao... \r\nAnyway, gotta jet. Maybe our paths will cross again soon.

no.0: You know I have ways of FORCING you to keep quiet, right?

1.0: So Tess is Kyrin's older brother. He's kind of strange, but I suppose I can keep his secret.

yes.0: He said something big's going to happen soon. What does he mean?
